reason: v12's directive regex treats an unclosed `%%{` as a directive and removes it, with the rest of the text after it (so later statements vanish); v13's preprocess keeps the text and reports UNCLOSED_DIRECTIVE, so the chart is rejected rather than silently cut (core preprocess behaviour; GAPS #300, #301).
